description: This file defines a React functional component 'CloudLink' responsible for rendering the cloud backups preferences UI, managing state for user entitlements and email notification settings, and handling interactions with application settings and features.

methods.name: loadIsFailedCloudBackupEmailMutedSetting
methods.description: An asynchronous callback to load the user's email notification muted setting and update the state.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Updates a user setting via the application settings API and returns a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: toggleMuteFailedCloudBackupEmails
methods.description: Toggles the email notification muted setting for failed cloud backups and updates the configuration.
